brief: UBS sales desk tracks quant and fundamental L/S positioning. US Quants paused after being active deleveraging all five sessions last week, but still cut a further -0.7std of gross yesterday, with performance challenging (-48bps) and the model foreseeing more deleveraging today; US Equity L/S paused Friday. In Japan, Equity L/S stays switched on and Quant has resumed because of tough performance. Yesterday's US rally was supported by Equity L/S net buying (+1std, split ~50/50 new longs/covering), led by Hyperscalers, US Software and Transportation, skewed to High Quality factor names. Despite this buying, Equity L/S performance fell a further -64bps, caught offside the rally because funds had already heavily de-risked and added hedging shorts to Industrials and Tech. In Europe, flows de-grossed (-1.0std): funds sold longs (-1.1std, concentrated in Tech & Hardware profit-taking, +80bps to performance) and covered shorts (+0.5std, concentrated in Food, Bevs & Tobacco, which squeezed higher).
